title: Session platform mix
description: Sessions grouped by the device information reported by the client.
query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN clientDevice LIKE '%iPhone%'  THEN 'iPhone'
    WHEN clientDevice LIKE '%iPad%'   THEN 'iPad'
    WHEN clientDevice LIKE 'tablet%'   THEN 'Tablet'
    WHEN clientDevice LIKE 'desktop%'  THEN 'Desktop'
    WHEN clientDevice LIKE 'mobile%'   THEN 'Mobile (non-iOS)'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS `Platform`,
  COUNT(*) AS `Sessions`
FROM altinstar.PlayerSession
WHERE `start` >= :since AND `start` < :until
GROUP BY `Platform`
ORDER BY `Sessions` DESC
notes: One player may generate many sessions or use more than one platform. Shares describe sessions, not unique players. Device labels are inferred from clientDevice: the mobile prefix alone does not prove Android. Unknown devices stay in Other. A platform gaining share is not automatically good or bad.

title: Top non-iOS mobile devices
description: The 15 most-used non-iOS mobile device labels, ranked by sessions.
query:
SELECT
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(clientDevice, ';', 4), ';', -1) AS `Device`,
  COUNT(*) AS `Sessions`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS `Players`
FROM altinstar.PlayerSession
WHERE `start` >= :since AND `start` < :until
  AND clientDevice LIKE 'mobile%'
  AND clientDevice NOT LIKE '%iPhone%'
  AND clientDevice NOT LIKE '%iPad%'
GROUP BY `Device`
HAVING `Sessions` > 50
ORDER BY `Sessions` DESC
LIMIT 15
notes: Device labels are parsed from the fourth semicolon-delimited clientDevice field. The mobile prefix and exclusions are a classification heuristic, not verified operating-system detection. Only device labels with more than 50 sessions appear. Players are distinct within each device and can appear under several devices. This is a ranked subset, not the entire device population.

title: Active players by country
description: Top 10 countries by distinct players who started a session during the selected range.
query:
SELECT
  country AS `Country`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS `Active players`
FROM altinstar.PlayerSession
WHERE `start` >= :since AND `start` < :until
  AND country IS NOT NULL
  AND country <> ''
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY `Active players` DESC
LIMIT 10
notes: This is a whole-range active-player count, not daily active users. A player is counted once per country but may appear in several countries. Missing or blank country values are excluded. Only the top 10 countries are shown; their sum is not a global unique-player total.

title: New-player return rate
description: Share of eligible new players who returned on calendar days 1-7 or 1-28 after signup.
query:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT LEAST(:until, COALESCE(MAX(`start`), :until)) AS cutoff
  FROM altinstar.PlayerSession
), cohorts AS (
  SELECT p.id, DATE(p.joined) AS joined_day,
         DATE_FORMAT(p.joined, :bucket) AS bucket,
         b.cutoff,
         CASE :bucket
           WHEN '%Y-%m-%d %H:00' THEN STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(p.joined, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') + INTERVAL 1 HOUR
           WHEN '%Y-%m-%d' THEN DATE(p.joined) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
           WHEN '%x-W%v' THEN DATE(p.joined) - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(p.joined) DAY + INTERVAL 7 DAY
           WHEN '%Y-%m' THEN DATE(p.joined) - INTERVAL (DAYOFMONTH(p.joined) - 1) DAY + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
           WHEN '%Y' THEN MAKEDATE(YEAR(p.joined) + 1, 1)
         END AS period_end
  FROM altinstar.Player p CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE p.joined >= :since AND p.joined < :until
    AND p.authType <> 'PRIVATE'
), eligible AS (
  SELECT * FROM cohorts
  WHERE period_end + INTERVAL 28 DAY <= cutoff
), flags AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.bucket,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ps.`start` < c.joined_day + INTERVAL 8 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_7d,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ps.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_28d
  FROM eligible c
  LEFT JOIN altinstar.PlayerSession ps
    ON ps.player_id = c.id
   AND ps.`start` >= c.joined_day + INTERVAL 1 DAY
   AND ps.`start` < c.joined_day + INTERVAL 29 DAY
  GROUP BY c.id, c.bucket
)
SELECT bucket,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(returned_7d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS `Returned within 7 days (%)`,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(returned_28d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS `Returned within 28 days (%)`,
       COUNT(*) AS `Eligible new players`,
       SUM(returned_7d) AS `Returned within 7 days`,
       SUM(returned_28d) AS `Returned within 28 days`
FROM flags
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
replaces: New Players — Do They Come Back?
notes: Each point groups players by signup period, not the date they returned. Day 0 is excluded. A session on any of days 1-7 counts in both rates; days 8-28 count only in the 28-day rate. This is cumulative return behavior, not exact-day D7 or D28 retention. PRIVATE accounts are excluded, matching the registration definition. Both rates use the same eligible-player denominator. Only signup periods whose entire calendar period plus 28 days has elapsed at the cutoff are included, so recent periods are intentionally absent. The cutoff is the earlier of the requested end and the latest session timestamp; it is not proof of replication completeness. The first period can be clipped by the requested start. Counts remain available in Table but only the two rates are plotted. Example: 2 of 5 players returning by day 7 is 40%; 3 of 5 by day 28 is 60%.

title: Rooms created and ended
description: Rooms created in each period, alongside how many have a recorded end timestamp.
query:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(creation, :bucket) AS bucket,
       COUNT(*)               AS `Rooms created`,
       SUM(`end` IS NOT NULL) AS `Rooms with an end`
FROM altinstar.Room
WHERE creation >= :since AND creation < :until
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
notes: Both series are grouped by room creation time. The ended count includes rooms that ended later, so historical values can change. A created room does not necessarily mean a played game. The gap includes in-progress rooms and rooms with missing end records; it cannot by itself establish abandonment.

title: New registrations
description: Player records created in each period, with the subset marked as having a referrer.
query:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(joined, :bucket) AS bucket,
       COUNT(*)                                          AS `Registrations`,
       SUM(CASE WHEN haveReferrer = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `With referral`
FROM altinstar.Player
WHERE authType <> 'PRIVATE' AND joined >= :since AND joined < :until
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
notes: Registrations are records, not necessarily unique humans or activated players. PRIVATE accounts and NULL authType values are excluded by the existing authType filter. With referral is a subset of registrations, so do not add the two series. A referral flag is an attribution signal, not proof of causation or acquisition quality.

title: Registration method mix
description: All-history distribution of registration methods for non-PRIVATE player records.
query:
SELECT CASE authType
         WHEN 'EMAIL'    THEN 'Email'
         WHEN 'FACEBOOK' THEN 'Facebook'
         WHEN 'GOOGLE'   THEN 'Google'
         WHEN 'APPLE'    THEN 'Apple'
         WHEN 'GATEWAY'  THEN 'Gateway'
         WHEN ''         THEN 'Guest / none'
         ELSE authType
       END AS `Auth method`,
       COUNT(*) AS `Players`
FROM altinstar.Player
WHERE authType <> 'PRIVATE'
GROUP BY authType ORDER BY `Players` DESC
notes: This query does not use the dashboard time range. It measures the historical signup method stored on Player, not current login activity or authentication success. Empty authType is Guest / none; NULL authType is excluded by the filter. Shares describe returned player records.

title: Referral share of registrations
description: Percentage of non-PRIVATE registrations marked as having a referrer in each period.
query:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(joined, :bucket) AS bucket,
       ROUND(100*SUM(CASE WHEN haveReferrer = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS `Referred %`
FROM altinstar.Player
WHERE authType <> 'PRIVATE' AND joined >= :since AND joined < :until
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
notes: Calculation: referred registrations divided by all eligible registrations, multiplied by 100. Both counts use the same signup-time range and authType filter. Rate changes are in percentage points: 10% to 12% is +2 pp. Do not average bucket percentages to obtain a whole-range rate; use the summed numerator divided by the summed denominator.

title: Active players and sessions
description: Distinct players and total sessions started in each time group.
query:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`start`, :bucket) AS bucket,
       COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS `Active players`,
       COUNT(*)                  AS `Sessions`
FROM altinstar.PlayerSession
WHERE `start` >= :since AND `start` < :until
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
notes: Active players are distinct within each group: daily groups give daily active players; monthly groups give monthly active players. Do not sum these values to obtain unique players across the full range. Sessions measure visits, not duration. Session records are not filtered by account type in this query, so its population differs from registration metrics. The saved default is daily over the last 30 days.

title: Room variant mix
description: Rooms created during the range, grouped by their detailed game variant.
query:
SELECT CASE hGameType
         WHEN 'Okey.N101.Normal'        THEN 'Okey 101'
         WHEN 'Okey.N101.Trump'         THEN 'Okey 101 (Trump)'
         WHEN 'Okey.Duz'                THEN 'Okey Düz'
         WHEN 'Backgammon.Tavla'        THEN 'Backgammon'
         WHEN 'Cardgames.Pisti'         THEN 'Pişti'
         WHEN 'Cardgames.Poker.Turkish' THEN 'Turkish Poker'
         ELSE COALESCE(hGameType,'Unknown')
       END AS `Game type`, COUNT(*) AS `Rooms`
FROM altinstar.Room
WHERE creation >= :since AND creation < :until
GROUP BY hGameType ORDER BY `Rooms` DESC
notes: Counts describe created rooms, including unfinished or unplayed rooms. Labels use hGameType; unrecognized variants retain their source value and NULL is Unknown. Shares show the returned room total. Volume alone cannot establish preference, quality, or successful completion.

title: Rooms without a recorded end
description: Percentage of rooms created in each period that currently have no end timestamp.
query:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(creation, :bucket) AS bucket,
       ROUND(100*SUM(`end` IS NULL)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS `Without end %`
FROM altinstar.Room
WHERE creation >= :since AND creation < :until
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
notes: This is an unfinished-room signal, not a verified abandonment rate. It includes rooms in progress and missing end records. Historical values may fall as rooms finish. Compare elapsed periods and investigate alongside room volume; a lower value generally indicates a more complete set of end records, not necessarily a causal improvement in player experience. A true abandonment metric needs an agreed timeout or terminal-state definition.

title: Okey penalty reasons
description: Penalty events recorded in the selected range, grouped by reason.
query:
SELECT reason AS `Reason`, COUNT(*) AS `Penalties`
FROM altinstar.OkeyEventPlayerPenalty
WHERE `date` >= :since AND `date` < :until
GROUP BY reason ORDER BY `Penalties` DESC
notes: Counts represent penalty events, not unique penalized players or games. A volume increase may reflect more gameplay rather than more friction. Compare against eligible gameplay volume before interpreting a rate. Reasons can suggest areas to investigate; they do not establish exploit attempts or confusing UX on their own.
